title: CC0 sound-effects library (136 files)
what_it_does: 136 short sound effects (whoosh, click, pop, riser, impact, tick, typing, glitch, ding, ambience) trimmed and peak-normalised, with a manifest of source, author and licence per file and a default kit of seven.
when_to_use: Putting real sound on every cue in a motion piece.
why: Verified: LICENSES.md says all bundled files are CC0 (Kenney packs and per-file CC0 Freesound), 2.6 MB. The 'typing' kit sound is a Mixkit download at runtime and must not be bundled. Keep LICENSES.md with the files.
